corrections_applied: See contracts/CHANGELOG.md and docs/pathways/DECISION_LOG.md DEC-C3, C4, C5, DEC-H3+, DEC-N and docs/pathways/PHASE4_DECISION_ENGINE_SPEC_V1.md. Source pack version: 1.0.0-candidate (preserved verbatim at docs/pathways/pack/contracts/taxonomy.json). Every base model, overlay, support, opportunity and review signal below now carries an explicit reachability_status so Phase 4 validation and reporting can distinguish ACTIVE, RESERVED, RETIRED, BASELINE and EXCLUDED items rather than leaving reachability implicit. ACTIVE = reachable by at least one rule in contracts/rules.json (or, for review signals, wired outside the rules engine as documented). RESERVED = a real taxonomy entry intentionally not yet reachable in Discovery V1; its ID/description are kept but it must never appear as a personalized result, and its presence must not fail an active-rule reachability check. RETIRED = deprecated, kept for explainability only. EXCLUDED = permanently unavailable in this version regardless of score or unmet need (B10 only). BASELINE = always potentially offered as a possible service, not gated by a scoring rule (S01 only). Phase 3E discovery calibration: OP04 moved ACTIVE->RETIRED (dual-enrollment/college-courses merged into one concept targeting OP05); OP07/OP09/OP12 moved RESERVED->ACTIVE (DISC_022 now captures work-based learning, industry credentials and entrepreneurship directly). Phase 4 (DEC-N) adds three new review_signals -- REV_PROGRAM_MANAGEMENT (rule PAR_002, family_management_preference = PROGRAM_LED), REV_ATTENDANCE_CONTEXT (rule ACAD_ATTENDANCE_001), REV_COMMUNICATION_CONTEXT (rule ACAD_COMMUNICATION_001) -- all global signals that never scope or downgrade a specific candidate card.

base_models.label: Future Pathways Mastery Program
base_models.excluded_note: Excluded throughout Discovery V1 by permanent architectural rule (discovery_enabled: false; no rule, builder flag, empty result or sales preference may activate it), not by omission. This does not cancel the separately planned future school model (Model 3); it means this version of Discovery never surfaces it.

supports.label: Pathways advising
supports.reachability_note: Resolves DEC-C4 (Phase 0 audit). Not gated by any rule in contracts/rules.json by design: advising is the product's universal next step, not a candidate-specific signal. Whether a consultation/advising CTA is actually available comes from operational service configuration (the consultation adapter), never from this taxonomy entry alone, and never implies an advisor has already been assigned or purchased.

supports.label: College planning
supports.reachability_note: Became reachable at Phase 0 corrections via new rule ADV_008 (DEC-C4).

opportunities.label: Dual-enrollment exploration
opportunities.reachability_note: Retired at Phase 3E discovery calibration: DISC_022's DUAL_ENROLLMENT and COLLEGE_COURSES are merged into one family-facing concept (canonical value COLLEGE_LEVEL_COURSES), which targets OP05 (College-course exploration) alone via ADV_004. ADV_003, the only rule that ever targeted OP04, is retired with no replacement targeting this opportunity. Kept, not deleted, so a historical run recorded against it stays explainable.

Empty score_effects (reason_type FEASIBILITY) -- see scoring-policy.json's material_review_mapping and postprocess_rules for the full cost-neutrality statement (DEC-H2/DEC-N).

Added at Phase 4 (PHASE4_DECISION_ENGINE_SPEC_V1.md section 16): verify how much day-to-day instruction, scheduling, progress monitoring, communication and family coordination a program actually provides when family_management_preference = PROGRAM_LED. No educational positive score derives from this review; triggered by rule PAR_002.

Added at Phase 4 (PHASE4_DECISION_ENGINE_SPEC_V1.md section 19): understand whether schedule, environment, logistics, health-related absences, family circumstances or another factor is affecting attendance before drawing conclusions -- never infers a cause. Global signal, never candidate-scoped. Triggered by rule ACAD_ATTENDANCE_001.

Added at Phase 4 (PHASE4_DECISION_ENGINE_SPEC_V1.md section 19): clarify what communication or coordination support the family is seeking. Global signal, never candidate-scoped, no school-model score. Triggered by rule ACAD_COMMUNICATION_001.

Resolved at Phase 0 corrections (DEC-C5) as architecturally outside the rules engine by design, not a gap: this signal reflects whether Pathways advising is actually live for the family's location, resolved by the Phase 6 consultation adapter, and affects only the report's CTA/service-availability explanation, never educational scoring. See contracts/rules.json review_signal_notes for the full statement. Not expected to ever appear in a Phase 4 rules.json reachability check, and its absence there must not fail that check.

constraints: Never confuse an overlay or service with a school of record.
Current school is not assumed public, tuition-free, in-person, or high-support.
Online does not guarantee asynchronous scheduling, low adult involvement, or legal cross-state attendance.
No public numerical ability, fit or family-value score.
No provider IDs or invented real schools in Discovery V1.
B10 remains unavailable regardless of score or unmet need.

RESERVED opportunities (OP13, OP15) must never be displayed as a personalized opportunity in a Discovery Report; their existence in this file must not cause a Phase 4 reachability check to fail. (OP07, OP09 and OP12 were reserved for the same reason at Phase 0 but moved to ACTIVE at Phase 3E once DISC_022 gained questions that capture them -- see contracts/CHANGELOG.md.)
